subject: PilotHealth MAP: POC priming & infra checklist
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pilothealth.io>, Pilot Health IT <it@pilothealth.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PilotHealth MAP: POC priming & infra checklist

Hi Samira + team,

Thank you again for choosing Redwood for the upcoming POC. Attached is a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) draft focused on environment priming so we can get smoke tests and an evaluation window started quickly. High-level asks to close the pre-provisioning phase: 

- Org setup: confirm the email address that will own the Pilot Health org in Redwood and desired RBAC for SRE/devs.
- API keys: which scopes are required for your test runners? (read/write embeddings/generation)
- IP allowlist: list of CIDR blocks for your outbound egress and any static IPs we should allow for callbacks.
- VPC peering: desired peering region & preferred CIDR; we'll share a minimal template to submit to your network team.

Please review the attached MAP_v1_PilotHealth.xlsx for milestone dates. Proposed kickoff: Nov 4 (30 min). If you can confirm the procurement contact and target eval start date, we can lock resources.

Attachments: MAP_v1_PilotHealth.xlsx (spreadsheet — MAP draft)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

Thanks — the MAP looks like the right level of detail. A couple clarifying questions before the kickoff:

- Can you share a sample VPC peering request (template) and the minimal metadata our network team will need?
- For API keys: what scopes will the evaluation harness require? We want to scope least-privilege for the keys the CI team will use.

I'll loop in procurement once we have the timeline. Our network lead (it@pilothealth.io) is copied.

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PilotHealth MAP: POC priming & infra checklist

Hi Samira — attaching the peering template and a minimal API key scope example. See inline answers below.

API key scopes (recommended minimal):
- inference:read (for logs/observability)
- inference:generate (for test harness calls)
- embeddings:read (if you plan to validate embeddings)
Notes: We will issue a timeboxed key tied to the Pilot Health org and can rotate at any time.

VPC peering template: attached vpc_peering_request.json (stub). Minimal fields your network team needs: requester VPC CIDR, region, account ID, contact for routing. If your team requires a /24 or larger on our side, let us know and we'll coordinate with infra.

IP allowlist: we can provide a set of static egress ranges for callbacks and the ingestion endpoint. If you have a NAT gateway range you want accepted, send the CIDRs.

Proposed milestone cadence (from MAP_v1):
- Nov 1–3: finalize contacts, peering template & API scope
- Nov 4: kickoff + network handoff (30 min)
- Nov 5–10: provisioning & smoke tests
- Nov 11: evaluation window opens

Attachments: vpc_peering_request.json (text stub)

Lauren Bishop
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Samira — quick note from our infra side:

- We can accept peering in us-west-2 and will allocate the requested /16 range if that works for you.
- For the smoke tests we only need temporary inbound rules for the test execution hosts; we'll provide IPs during the provisioning window (Nov 5–10).
- Rishi, can you confirm the ephemeral key TTL and rotation cadence we should advertise to their security team?

I can be on the kickoff call Nov 4 at 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
